pairs: a timore inimici eripe animam meam.
Rescue my soul from the fear of the enemy.
You have protected me from the assembly of the malignant,
from a multitude of workers of iniquity.
Quia exacuerunt ut gladium linguas suas;
For they have sharpened their tongues like a sword;
they have formed their bow into a bitter thing,
so that they may shoot arrows from hiding at the immaculate.
They will suddenly shoot arrows at him,
and they will not be afraid.
They are resolute in their wicked talk.
They have been searching carefully for iniquities.
Man will approach with a deep heart,
Sagittæ parvulorum factæ sunt plagæ eorum,
The arrows of the little ones have become their wounds,
et infirmatæ sunt contra eos linguæ eorum.
and their tongues have been weakened against them.
Conturbati sunt omnes qui videbant eos,
All those who saw them have been troubled;
And they announced the works of God,
The just will rejoice in the Lord,
and they will hope in him.
And all the upright of heart will be praised.
